challenge_facts_addressed.effect_on_judgment: Two Alex-initiated one-on-one plans, including a Saturday museum visit, meaningfully support possible special interest, though C1-F4 shows Alex also makes one-on-one plans with other friends.
Remembering the presentation, sending encouragement, and bringing Jordan's preferred tea demonstrate personalized attention, but C1-F4 indicates that Alex also checks on and brings treats to others.
Four extended private conversations after group events provide the strongest indication that Alex particularly enjoys engaging with Jordan, but they do not by themselves establish romantic interest.

reason_for_retaining_or_changing: B remains the primary conclusion, but with reduced confidence because C1-F1 through C1-F3 collectively show repeated, individualized attention rather than a single ambiguous gesture. Even so, C1-F4 establishes a broader pattern of warmth and similar behavior toward others, while C1-F5 contains no explicit romantic signal and C1-F6 shows no prompt effort to reschedule Jordan's proposed dinner. General friendliness therefore remains better supported, though A is a substantial possibility.

revised_recommended_action.explanation: The mixed pattern does not justify assuming romantic interest; observing whether Alex initiates or reschedules further one-on-one contact would provide clearer evidence.
